name: Wraith

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wraith has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets a Humanoid corpse within 10 feet of itself that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute. The target's spirit rises as a {@creature Specter|XMM} in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at a time.

fluffEntries: Wraith: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 8 para o modo fatal.
